recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit; changing the current source back to the exact Jira proposal wording would not change implementer understanding and would be a less-polished restatement of already-applied content.
issue_request: FHIR-27041 was a Published/Persuasive CDS change request for R5 asking to update PlanDefinition.goal to describe an expected outcome within the plan and include pharmaceutical quality acceptance-criteria examples.
initial_application: The Jira comments point to HL7/fhir PR #1043 and PR #1134. Git history shows PR #1043 changed the older PlanDefinition spreadsheet from the prior wording to the acceptance-criteria wording, and PR #1134 carried that same wording into source/plandefinition/structuredefinition-PlanDefinition.xml.
additional_context: PlanDefinition is active in source/fhir.ini and assigned to CDS. The current XML source keeps the requested concepts with editorially improved phrasing. A 2023 BRR Confluence minute also quotes the PlanDefinition.goal acceptance-criteria phrase as existing specification text. The sibling FHIR-27042 target-detail example request was applied through the same PR family and already has a separate combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: No source edit was made. The current authoritative StructureDefinition already says a goal is an expected outcome that activities within the plan are intended to achieve and includes meeting acceptance criteria for a test specified by a quality specification.

related_jiras.note: Sibling PlanDefinition.goal.target.detail example request from the same PQ/CMC PR family; it is already represented on the combined branch by a separate audit commit.
